verdict.rationale: Elastic's own marketing says users can interact with their telemetry in natural language, and ES|QL is positioned as the engine behind AI investigations. No evidence shows that a natural-language question yields a real ES|QL/PromQL query or a chart. Missing for 10: documented natural-language-to-query generation, chart or visualization output from natural-language prompts, in-depth first-party docs on the assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
ES|QL delivers sub-second responses on millions of time series metrics — the speed AI investigations demand.
